photographic_observations: One low above-grade storey is visible at the photographed principal facade.
The visible roof edge is horizontal and parapeted; the membrane/roof surface itself is not visible.
The long facade has a reddish-brown brick segment, a broad pale vertically ribbed metal-clad segment, a recessed dark glazed entry bay, and a shallow dark canopy above the glazing.
The photo does not encode its compass bearing or provide scale/exif camera measurements, so facade orientation and absolute height remain uncertain.
uncertainty: The source is an official building-specific exterior image, but image date, viewpoint bearing, architectural plans, material specification and measured elevation are absent. Observations support facade style only; 4.2 m model height remains an estimate.
